text:
Marta (People Ops): Hey team — planning a small 'Coffee & Kudos' drop for next Wed (June 3) at HQ + remote care packages shipped same day. Goal: quick spot-awards + handwritten postcard for 50 folks. Volunteers? :coffee::confetti:

James (Office Ops): I can handle the coffee cart logistics. Where to store postcards?

Kelly (People Ops): I'll coordinate postcards. @Anna can you confirm headcount + addresses for remote folks?

Anna (HR Systems): Uploading list shortly. We need employee consent for mailing? Payroll team ok with names on envelopes?

Jamal (Payroll): fine with names. If personal addresses included, we'll need opt-in note. Also budget?

Marta (People Ops): Budget approved up to $800. Vendor is Bean&Bean mobile cart. Need volunteer to do 9:30-11am shift.

Priya (Eng): Happy to volunteer 9:30-10:30.

Marta (People Ops): Perfect. @Kelly can you paste the shipping CSV format? We'll need it for vendor.

Kelly (People Ops): Sure — CSV template below:

```
name,address_line1,address_line2,city,state,zip,remote_or_on_site,award_reason
Alex Chen,123 Elm St,,Seattle,WA,98101,remote,Exceptional triage on incident
Samira Patel,500 Market Ave,Apt 2,San Francisco,CA,94105,remote,Consistent code review excellence
Jordan Lee,600 3rd St,Suite 4,New York,NY,10012,on-site,Helped ship Q2 alpha
```

Anna (HR Systems): Uploading final list to #internal-docs in 15m. Count: 52 (12 remote).

James (Office Ops): Where to leave confetti cones? We should avoid lounges where carpet.

Marta (People Ops): Great point — coffee cart on 6th floor atrium, confetti cones at tables (no carpet). Also printing postcards — @Greg can you print?

Greg (Facilities): Can print 60 postcards by Tuesday EOD. Will drop to mailroom.

Kelly (People Ops): I'll draft the kudos script for volunteers and a 2-line template for handwritten notes.

Priya (Eng): Can we get a small laminated sign for 'Spot Awards' so people know how to nominate on the spot?

Lia (Design): On it — draft by tomorrow morning, will post in this thread.

Marta (People Ops): Awesome. Final checklist:
- coffee cart confirmed (James)
- postcards printed (Greg)
- shipping list & consents (Anna)
- volunteers 9:30-11 (Priya + one more)
- sign/digital artwork (Lia)
- vendor CSV ready (Kelly)

Please react with :thumbsup: if you're set or ping if you need help.
